summary.name: DeepL
summary.one_liner: DeepL Marketplace page listing DeepL's free apps and integrations for translation and writing across desktop, mobile, browsers, and office tools.
use_cases: translate web pages in a browser
translate emails in Outlook or Gmail
get writing suggestions in multiple languages
translate across language barriers on a phone
connect translation to AI agents via MCP
summary.what_it_does: The page is a marketplace listing of DeepL-built apps and integrations, most marked as free downloads. Listed items include desktop apps for macOS and Windows, iOS and Android apps, and extensions for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. Office and workspace integrations are also listed for Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Google Docs, Google Slides, and Gmail. A DeepL for AI agents entry says it works with Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and other MCP-supporting agents. The page also lists third-party partner integrations, such as Salesforce, Oracle Eloqua, and memoQ, but these are not DeepL's own products.
notable: Free desktop, mobile, and browser apps listed as free downloads
DeepL for AI agents connects translation to Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and MCP-compatible agents
Office and Google Workspace add-ins for Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Docs, Slides, and Gmail
caveats: Page does not state whether all features in the free apps are free; pricing details are on other DeepL pages
Many marketplace entries are third-party partner apps rather than DeepL's own products
